I can help. First, I need to identify your account so I can check your line and data status.

- Please provide your mobile phone number (the one with the issue). If you prefer, you can share your customer ID instead.

While I pull up your line, can you run two quick checks on your phone and share the results?
1) Run check_status_bar and tell me:
   - Airplane mode icon present or not
   - Signal strength (No Signal / 1–4 bars)
   - Network type shown (5G/4G/3G/2G)
   - Mobile data status (Data Enabled/Disabled)
2) Run run_speed_test and tell me the result label (unknown / very poor / poor / fair / good / excellent).

Also, are you currently traveling outside your usual coverage area (roaming)?

- Wait 30–60 seconds.

2) Turn off any data limits
- Run check_data_restriction_status. If Data Saver is ON, run toggle_data_saver_mode to turn it OFF.

3) Make sure no VPN is slowing things down
- Run check_vpn_status. If a VPN is connected, run disconnect_vpn.

4) Recheck and test

  • Signal strength (No Signal / 1–4 bars)
  • Network type (5G/4G/3G/2G)
  • Mobile data status (Enabled/Disabled)
- Then run run_speed_test and share the result label.

If it’s still stuck on 2G or very slow after the above, run reboot_device once, wait 1–2 minutes after it comes back, and repeat step 4. Share the results so I can proceed.
